assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 YRF 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方：Yash Raj Films。企业隶属关系链。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言（印地语）。
  6. 主要内容类别（音乐／宝莱坞）。
  7. 内容供应模式：授权音乐曲库。
  8. 代表作品。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，YRF 排名第 37 名，历史累计观看量约为 61B（610 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 YRF 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
YRF (Yash Raj Films) YouTube Channel Dossier

  1. STABLE CHANNEL ID & CANONICAL URL:
  • Channel ID: UCbTLwN10NoCU4WDzLf1JMOA
  • Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCbTLwN10NoCU4WDzLf1JMOA
  • Handle: @yrf (also https://www.youtube.com/@yrf)
  • Source: Google search results showing the channel page directly
  1. OPERATOR & CORPORATE CHAIN:
  • Operator: Yash Raj Films Pvt. Ltd.
  • Type: Privately held Indian film production and distribution company
  • Founded: 1970 by filmmaker Yash Chopra
  • Current leadership: Aditya Chopra (Chairman & MD since 2012), Akshaye Widhani (CEO)
  • No parent company; operates independently (rejected Disney's 49% acquisition offer in 2009)
  • Sub-channels: YRF Movies, YRF Music, YRF Trailers, YRF Dialogues, YRF Trivia, YRF Punjabi, YRF Arabic, plus ~40 total network channels
  • Sources: Wikipedia, Bollyspice, afaqs.com
  1. CHANNEL CREATION DATE & EARLIEST STILL-PUBLIC UPLOAD:
  • Created: June 7, 2006 (per Social Blade)
  • Earliest still-public uploads found: January 5, 2009 ("Thoda Pyaar Thoda Magic | Teaser") and February 16, 2009 ("Zinda Rehti Hai Unki Mohabbatein | Song Promo")
  • Note: Channel was created in 2006 but earliest identifiable public uploads date to early 2009; earlier 2007-2008 uploads may have been removed or made private
  • Sources: Social Blade, individual video pages
  1. OPERATING LOCATION & DISPLAYED COUNTRY:
  • Operating location: Mumbai, India (YRF Studios, Andheri West, Mumbai)
  • Displayed country: India (confirmed via Tubefilter chart showing India flag icon)
  • Sources: Tubefilter, Wikipedia, LinkedIn
  1. LANGUAGES:
  • Primary language: Hindi
  • Channel description references Hindi Songs, Bollywood content
  • Sources: YouTube channel metadata, Bollyspice
  1. PRIMARY CONTENT CATEGORY:
  • Film & Animation (#1 in India in this category; #9 worldwide per 2016 data)
  • Content mix: Bollywood film songs, trailers, clips, lyrical videos, jukeboxes, interviews, behind-the-scenes
  • Sources: Bollyspice, afaqs.com, Tubefilter
  1. CONTENT SUPPLY MODEL:
  • YRF owns its entire music catalog and film IP; YouTube serves as promotional/marketing channel for movie releases
  • YRF's Licensing Division protects repertoire under Copyright Act and monetizes through licensing across TV, radio, digital, consumer products
  • Content includes official music videos, trailers, clips, jukeboxes - all produced/distributed by YRF itself
  • Described by VP Digital Anand Gurnani as "key channel of content dissemination for movie marketing"
  • Note: Content is YRF-owned catalog distributed on-platform, not licensed from third-party labels
  • Sources: yashrajfilms.com/licensing, Bollyspice, afaqs.com
  1. REPRESENTATIVE WORKS (by views, per Kworb.net):
  • Tujh Mein Rab Dikhta Hai (Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi) - 1.52B views
  • Jhoome Jo Pathaan (Pathaan) - 1.28B views
  • Saiyaara (Ek Tha Tiger) - 935M views
  • Besharam Rang (Pathaan) - 845M views
  • Kajra Re (Bunty Aur Babli) - 674M views
  • Main Yahaan Hoon (Veer-Zaara) - 636M views
  • Dil To Pagal Hai - 586M views
  • Dhoom Machale (Dhoom) - 431M views
  • Jag Ghoomeya (Sultan) - 556M views
  • Ho Gaya Hai Tujhko (DDLJ) - 492M views
  • Sources: Kworb.net, YouTube

ADDITIONAL STATISTICS:

  • Subscribers: 72.7M (as of September 2026)
  • Total views: ~61B lifetime (per Communitrics snapshot Sept 2, 2026; Social Blade shows 61.1B+)
  • Total videos: 5,100+
  • Ranked among top 50 most-viewed YouTube channels globally
  • Daily average views: ~25.7M

evidence.supports: Channel creation date (June 7, 2006), subscriber count (~73M), lifetime views (~61B), video count (5.1K)
